messages:
elaine: Quick flag 5

- saw p50 > p99 on endpoint detail for a single 1m bucket on /v1/completions. Not a visual bug? :confused:

vik: That usually means different sources. Detail pulls histogram_shards, overview pulls tdigest_merged. If merge lags, numbers can differ.

sam: Can you paste minute and values?

elaine: 2025-03-14T16:02Z: detail p50=410ms, overview p99=390ms. Screenshot attached.

vik: Confirmed: merge job had ~40s delay; ingress showed a short heavy tail that the merged row didn't reflect until the next window.

sam: UX decision: make source explicit on every quantile tile and add a per-tenant default. Defaults: production dashboards = canonical_post_routing; dev/canary = ingress_early_detect.

elaine: Agree. Also add API param: quantile_source=post_routing|ingress|all so tooling can reproduce exact queries.

vik: Backend plan: metrics proxy honors quantile_source and returns counts_by_origin (ingress,routed,retry). Frontend: badge "Source: post-routing" with hover text explaining merge latency and SLO authority.

sam: Add visual legend: solid blue = canonical (post-routing), dashed orange = ingress (early). And a small "explain SQL" modal for power users.

elaine: Tests: unit test to assert monotonicity for same-source queries (p50 <= p95 <= p99). If inversion found in prod telemetry, log diagnostic and file a ticket.

vik: Also add a small-N warning: if sample_count < 50 show "small N: quantiles approximate" so customers don't overreact.

sam: Devops caveat: cache keys need to include quantile_source to avoid cross-source staleness. We'll namespace caches by source.

ops-bot: PRs opened: frontend console: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/3901 (badge + selector + explain modal), infra metrics-proxy: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/9480 (quantile_source + counts_by_origin + cache namespace).

elaine: I'll update runbook: "If overview vs detail disagree, check tile source and counts_by_origin. If ingress > 10% expect earlier anomalies. If sample_count < 50 expect approximation noise."

vik: Assign follow-ups: infra (vik) land proxy; frontend (sam) land UI + e2e; telemetry (elaine) add monotonicity logger.

elaine: great. Thanks all :thumbsup:
